data.catalog: Bundled snapshot; upload always revalidates against Apple's live catalog

principles: Lead with the main user outcome; prove it with the actual app screen.
Make the first three images a compact story: outcome, core action, differentiator.
Use one benefit per image. Start with 3–7 words per headline; this is a heuristic, not an Apple limit.
Use large, high-contrast type; inspect the set at a small App Store search-result size.
Capture populated, stable UI with fictional data. Avoid login, splash and loading screens.
Use captures from each device layout. Never stretch a phone screen into an iPad or Duo layout.
Localize both captions and visible app UI; have a native speaker review the final pixels.
Show real app functionality in more than half of every device/locale set; overlays must leave it visible.
Test one hypothesis with Product Page Optimization. Do not assume a design guarantees conversion lift.
advice.judgment: Editorial heuristics, not a conversion prediction or visual/OCR review.

experiment.hypothesis: An outcome-led first screenshot will improve download conversion versus the current first screenshot.
experiment.change: First-image headline only; hold other assets and locales constant.
experiment.measure: Use Apple Product Page Optimization conversion and confidence; review downstream retention/purchase quality.
experiment.stop: Use Apple's duration estimate; do not declare a winner from a small early swing.
